```{r}
CX1_treated <- TRUE 
print(CX1_treated)
CX2_treated <- FALSE
print(CX2_treated)
CX1_before <-5415
CX2_before<- 8123 
CX1_after <- 1432
CX2_after <- 7543

cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2" 
```

```{r}
library (tidyverse)
library (gt)
```
```{r}
cell_id_vec <- c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
print(cell_id_vec)
treated_vec <- c(CX1_treated, CX2_treated)
print(treated_vec)
before_vec <- c(CX1_before, CX2_before)
print(before_vec)
after_vec<- c(CX1_after, CX2_after)
print(after_vec)
```

```{r}
my_data_frame<- tibble(
  cell_id <- c("CX1", "CX2"),
  treated <- c(TRUE, FALSE),
  num_cells_before <- c(5415, 8123),
  num_cells_after <- c(1432, 7543)
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
